description: Run an Animation or Timeline command that acts on the selection: Enable Auto-keyframe (toggle), Select Equal / Previous / Following Keyframes, Select Keyframe Label Group (and its On Selected Layers, On All Layers and Visible Keyframes variants), Keyframe Assistant > Exponential Scale, RPF Camera Import and Create Keyframes from Data, Reveal in Timeline, Reveal Properties with Animation, Reveal All Modified Properties and Reveal Expression Errors. Select keyframes first with select_keyframes; layers (and property) given here are selected before the command runs

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition. It is opened in the Timeline first

layers.description: Select only these layers first (indexes, names, or selected: true to keep the selection)

property.description: With layers, also select this property (Reveal in Timeline). A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]

name: run_animation_command
title: Run Animation Command
